scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/api ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/api run test:e2e
